name: cx-siren
task: Go to the exit, and whenever the siren rings, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Go to the exit' is an unconditional hard command, so the hard Existence(at_exit) is the goal; 'whenever the siren rings, turn it off' is correctly Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) hard — every ringing step must be followed by a toggle on that step or later, and since toggling the switch is what silences the siren, the response closes on each toggle and re-arms if the siren starts again. The condition siren_ringing and the consequent switch_toggled correctly get no Existence, both clauses are hard as worded, both trace to the task, and neither is redundant; the machine's final state u2 requires the exit with no pending response.

texts: Whenever the siren rings, toggle the switch to turn it off.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!siren_ringing) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u3
(u0, at_exit&siren_ringing&switch_toggled) -> u2
(u1, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u0
(u1, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u3
(u1, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u2
(u3, switch_toggled) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u0, at_exit&!siren_ringing, u2) -> 11
(u0, at_exit&siren_ringing&switch_toggled, u2) -> 11
(u1, !at_exit&switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
(u1, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u3) -> 1
(u1, at_exit&switch_toggled, u2) -> 12
(u3, switch_toggled, u2) -> 11
